description: This file is a JUnit test class for the AdjustLoanTransactionCommandStrategy component of the Fineract project, specifically testing the execution of loan transaction adjustments in different scenarios.

classes.name: AdjustLoanTransactionCommandStrategyTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing the AdjustLoanTransactionCommandStrategy component's behavior in processing loan transaction adjustments.

methods.name: testExecuteWithoutCommandSuccessScenario
methods.description: Tests successful execution of adjusting a loan transaction without specifying a command.

methods.name: testExecuteWithCommandSuccessScenario
methods.description: Tests successful execution of adjusting a loan transaction with a specified command such as 'chargeback'.

methods.name: getBatchRequest
methods.description: Creates a BatchRequest object with specified loanId, transactionId, and optional transaction command, used for testing.
